app.name: Main App
app.summary:
A Next.js app entry point that combines the home page, metadata, and root layout with game state. It is the top level interface users open first.

Defines the home page and root layout, plus the solo, lightning, demo, multiplayer, leaderboard, and guess flow handlers. It imports the panorama viewer and shared helpers to run the main game experience.

Runs in the browser and at render time.

Uses Panorama Viewer and Shared Helpers. The page is the main consumer of both.
app.role: Handles the playable app experience and routes.

components components/ui.name: UI Toolkit
components components/ui.summary:
A component library made of composable React primitives for common interface patterns. It collects buttons, inputs, dialogs, sidebar pieces, and feedback widgets into one shared toolkit.

Exports Button, Sidebar, toast UI, form controls, and many other widgets used across the app. It also contains the sidebar provider and context that coordinate sidebar behavior.

Runs in the browser as imported React components.

Builds on UI Hooks and Utility Library. The app consumes these controls indirectly through its pages and features.
components components/ui.role: Provides reusable controls and layout primitives.

hooks.name: React Hooks
hooks.summary:
A hook module that packages client side state and browser event handling. It turns toast notifications and responsive breakpoints into reusable React hooks.

Implements the toast reducer, queue, dispatch helpers, and the useToast hook, plus mobile detection through useIsMobile. The UI kit uses these hooks for notifications and responsive behavior.

Runs in the browser as hook logic.

Supports UI Kit. It depends on Utility Library only through the UI layer's usage patterns.
hooks.role: Handles toast state and viewport checks.

lib.name: Shared Utils
lib.summary:
A pure helper module for small reusable functions. It is the place for class name merging and other generic formatting utilities.

Exports cn for joining class names, which the component layer uses for styling composition. It is a simple support module with no UI of its own.

Pure library with no runtime of its own.

Feeds UI Kit. The app and hooks reach it only through that component layer.

src/components.name: Panorama Viewer
src/components.summary:
A client side React wrapper around an imperative panorama viewer. It adapts props and browser globals to a viewer that is managed outside normal React rendering.

Defines PanoramaViewerProps, PanoramaViewer, and an initViewer method for wiring the scene up. The game page uses it to show the core visual experience.

Runs in the browser after mount.

Used by Game Shell. It likely depends on a browser global viewer API.
src/components.role: Embeds and initializes the panorama scene.

src/lib.name: Game Formatting Utils
src/lib.summary:
A pure utility module with helper functions for transforming values into user friendly text. It keeps common formatting and randomization logic away from the page code.

Exports shuffleArray, formatDistance, formatScore, formatYear, formatYearDiff, and cn. The app page uses these helpers for score display, distance text, year formatting, and shuffling.

Pure library with no runtime of its own.

Used by Game Shell. It shares the cn helper with the UI Kit.

src/data.name: Places Catalog
src/data.summary:
A static content module that models places and their trivia fragments. It is structured as data types plus a list of records for the rest of the app to read.

Defines TidbitKind, Tidbit, Place, and the places array. Other features can import this content to drive questions, hints, or place details.

Build time data module.

Can feed Game Shell or future features. Nothing in the provided symbols depends on it directly.
